name: claude-smart-notifier
description: Get a desktop notification when any Claude thread finishes or needs your answer. ✅ done · 🟡 needs answer · 🔴 urgent.
long_description: Running many Claude threads at once? Smart Notifier pings you with a native desktop notification (macOS / Windows) whenever a thread finishes or is waiting for you — with the project name and an ultra-short line saying what it needs. Three levels with their own emoji and sound. Zero dependencies.

tools.name: notify
tools.description: Show a desktop notification (done / question / urgent) with project name and a short message.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto = same language the thread replies in (falls back to system language). Or type a code: en, ru, uk, lt, lv, et, pl, de, fr, es, pt, it, nl, sv, no, da, fi, cs, sk, hu, ro, bg, sr, hr, sl, el, tr, he, ar, fa, hi, bn, ja, ko, zh, zh-tw, vi, th, id, ms, sw, ka, hy, kk, az, uz, be, ca.

sound_done.title: Sound: done (macOS)
sound_done.description: macOS sound name for finished tasks: Glass, Hero, Ping, Pop, Purr, Funk, Submarine, Blow, Basso, Sosumi, Tink.

sound_question.title: Sound: needs answer (macOS)
sound_question.description: macOS sound name when a thread waits for you.

sound_urgent.title: Sound: urgent (macOS)
sound_urgent.description: macOS sound name for blockers and errors.

mute.title: Mute all notifications
mute.description: Temporarily silence all notifications without uninstalling.
